checks.name: the 909 Kit is in the bank
SEL on the kit page arms it (909 KIT ARMED)
FX opens the Drive
#1347: the page header reads DRIVE OFF
SEL switches the Drive on (DRIVE ON)
#1347: the page header reads DRIVE
SEL switches the Drive off again (DRIVE OFF)
#1347: the page header reads DRIVE OFF
the kick changes with the Drive on (hit RMS or peak beyond the takes' spread)
and back with it off
SELECT walks to the Reverb
#1347: the page header reads REVERB OFF
SEL switches the Reverb on (REVERB ON)
#1347: the page header reads REVERB
SEL mid-tail switches the Reverb off (REVERB OFF)
the Reverb on lengthens the kick's tail (so the next check is not blind)
switched off 0.35 s after the hit, the Reverb rings out (tail 6 dB or more over the dry tail)
the 909 slot read before SAVE
SEL on again (REVERB ON)
SAVE kept the Reverb on: after a reload SEL turns it off (REVERB OFF)
the 909 slot written back as it was
